name: Shinonome Urara
source: [url=/c40828]Shuuji's[/url] classmate who often gets in trouble with the teachers due to her dyed hair and remodeled uniform. It was love at first sight for this girl when she bumped into Shuuji in the hallway, and ever since that fateful day, she has been attacking him from all the sides.
translation: [url=/c40828]Shuuji's[/url] classmate who often gets in trouble with the teachers due to her dyed hair and remodeled uniform.
